findings.title: Project route filtering performs quadratic session lookups
findings.what: sessionProject() uses Array.find across all sessions. Both project-filtered tool rows and project-filtered API-error rows invoke it once per row, so interactive filtering scales as O(rows × sessions). Large history datasets can therefore stall route-filtered views even though session-to-project attribution is static for the operation.
findings.fix: Build a Map from sessionId to project once per filtering call, or accept a pre-indexed lookup shared by both filters, then resolve each row in O(1). Preserve the current undefined-session behavior.
findings.acceptance: Add a large-fixture test or benchmark with thousands of sessions and rows that instruments session lookup work and proves it grows linearly with rows plus sessions, while existing project-filter results remain byte-for-byte equivalent.
findings.verifyNote: Adversarially re-read the cited baseline functions. The linear Array.find is still present at src/lib/route-filtering.ts:32 and is called inside both row iterations at lines 47 and 101; neither function builds or receives an index, so the O(rows × sessions) behavior is reproducible whenever a project filter is active.
